comment: Irregular words. Each is cut into one tile per sound (`graphemes`), with what each tile says here given as the letter that usually says it (`sounds`). Which tiles carry a heart is not listed: it is every tile that does not say what the child has been taught so far. `on` and `in`: drawn things something else can be stood on, or put in, for the sentences a child reads. The game uses each word once its clip and its sounds' clips exist.
